notes.title: Leaderboard + Achievements!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hate.netters!![/h2][p]I have a new update for you. It has a few things you have been asking for, as well as a couple bug fixes I could fit in. I want to thank those of you who have stuck around and are still playing and interacting with it! I always like it when you reach out, make discussion posts, or leave reviews. I read all of it and it brings me a lot of joy and thought.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Update:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Leaderboard![/b] - One of my favorite parts of online games is the ability to compete with others for high scores, and it was a feature that I've wanted to add ever since release.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements! [/b]- Key milestones, secrets... There's a couple of things I've hidden in the game, though I won't reveal much more...
[i]NOTE: Due to how Steam handles adding achievements, I cannot test them until I set them to public. You will have to bear with the possibility that they might require an emergency patch later.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some smaller bug fixes/additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blocked off an escape route from endless arena[/p][/*][*][p]Removed bricks[/p][/*][*][p]Additional parkour section in lobby area[/p][/*][*][p]Invert mouse X/Y has been added to settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could press TAB to access post-processing on/off while outside menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Other topics:[/h2][list][*][p]The game is going on sale for this update! If you have a friend or know someone who has thought about buying it, here's an opportunity to grab it for a better deal![/p][/*][*][p]The game's soundtrack getting published has been put off until now, as this update contains one new music track... Stay tuned...[/p][/*][*][p]After this update, I will be taking some time off from this game to take a break for the rest of summer. It's been really cool seeing you all interact with my art, and I hope to give you more to indulge, but for that I need to be well-rested ːespressoː[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Stay cool, [/p][p]bonitaka[/p]

notes.title: The Endless Cycle Update + Discord Server!
notes.content: [h2]Hello hate.netters! [/h2][p](haters? not sure what way I would address you all, let me know if you really love/hate this nickname)... I hope you've been having fun playing my game so far.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Update:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Endless mode![/b] Some of you had a really quick time with the regular game, so here's a mode for all of you that like to put a podcast on in the background and tune out...[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Level![/b] I want to properly introduce players to the base mechanics, since some feedback showed that I didn't communicate it properly (that's on me! sorry!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug and exploit fixes! [/b]I can't promise I got all of them, but always be sure to let me know! Here's the current list of fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Kill floor no longer carries into a restart if the player dies right before it begins to rise;[/p][/*][*][p]High ground exploits should now be a little more curbed, as the upper layer of the level syncs up for when the kill floor begins to rise;[/p][/*][*][p]Moderator enemies now spawn in a less predictable way;[/p][/*][*][p]Blocking right after firing an explosion now no longer cancels out the block after cooldown;[/p][/*][*][p]Settings should be properly fixed and working, including mouse sensitivity and post-processing on/off stuff. If they don't... well, I'll fix it again[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]I hope you have fun playing! As always, let me know in the Steam discussion boards if something is broken or doesn't work the way your expected![/p][p][/p][h2]On other topics...[/h2][p]I launched a bonitāka [url="https://discord.gg/86VUZFKrSM"]discord server[/url]! <----- server invite here, for if you want to chat and hang out or just follow along my works :)[/p][p]Once again, this update does not mark the end of the game's support. I plan on continuing work on it, polishing and adding new things, while still keeping it a short and sweet experience... just not 20 minutes short... [/p][p]I feel like incremental updates is the way to go here. Let me know what you think though! If you'd rather one or two large updates over this game's lifespan versus multiple comparatively smaller updates, I will adjust my workflow for that. [/p][p]At the moment, I am finishing up work for my university deadlines, so I've been keeping busy on top of hate.net. ːespressoː[/p]

notes.title: Update progress + a brief thank you
notes.content: [p]Hello hate.netters!!![/p][p][/p][p]First off - I'm really grateful for the reception this project of mine has gotten so far! Seeing your screenshots and comments and thoughts has really motivated me and brought a huge smile on my face :) [/p][p]So, I've been working away at the update for the past few days, and it's been coming together quite well, I think. The current scope of the content update is as follows:[/p][list][*][p][b]Endless mode![/b] (for anybody looking for a longer experience that slowly ramps up in difficulty)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial level[/b] (for a more clear outline of the player's movement and combat mechanics!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slight tweaks[/b] [b]to combat[/b] (details in the patch notes when the update comes out, of course)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug / exploit [/b](I've been able to fix some of the more crucial bugs that break the game/player experience)[/p][/*][/list][p]Of course, this isn't the last you'll see new stuff pop up here and there for [b]hate (dot) net[/b] [i](I do not own the domain for hate. net, but if somebody wants to give me $10000 a month I'll gladly take it)[/i][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609922/bf672adf3c3c2f5caa64aa072b74915db7f2b84f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609922/d5d970041713ab63dbfe12ca0b21bc22a7c4e6dd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609922/b16b1d5ae4675c3dab602c1105fb8066c5e519b0.png"][/img][/carousel][p]The photos above:[/p][olist][*][p]Endless mode working as intended (no, I used debug cheats for the score :}, I am [i]not that good[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]A sneak peek at the endless mode level (in progress)[/p][/*][*][p]A corner of the tutorial level[/p][/*][/olist][p]While the update is not done yet, I wanted to let all of you know that I've been making progress on the things I have promised. I hope you all are excited to play this as I am excited to read your thoughts on it![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]bonitāka[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Day 1 patch (+ FUTURE UPDATE PLANS!)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Thank you for playing the game so far, and sharing your thoughts and impressions. I'm glad to hear some parts of the game have been pleasant to play and experience :)

As for the weaknesses, bugs, and points of improvement - I want to make this game better, and your input and patience is very important to me! More on that addressed later.

 I want to first get some initial bugs brought up out of the way, so see the patch notes below:

[list]
[*]fixed mouse sensitivity setting not saving correctly
[*]fixed screenshake settings not saving properly
[*]refactored the way settings get applied internally
[*]added FPS limit setting
[/list]
[h2]Future improvements[/h2]

So - on the topic of improving the game - I have read your reviews and comments so far, and I agree that there is a lack of content, especially in scaling difficulty and an endless mode setting. 

Without promising too much, I do intend to make an endless mode, and I want to rework the way late-game works in the current state of the game. The level does have some high-ground exploits, and I hope to fiddle around with some ways to push the player into my intended experience.

That being said, I am a solo developer and can only work on this part-time. I hope you can understand if I take a little longer than normal on some updates.

Thank you for sticking around so far, and I hope to hear and share more soon,
bonitāka
